title: Exotic Sweet Malaysian Tofu Satay
description: A sweet and snappy Malaysian dish featuring star anise and lacquer-glaze, perfect for a romantic evening, this plant-based friendly recipe is a must try.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender or food processor, combine coconut milk, brown sugar, rice vinegar, ground star anise, and salt, and blend until smooth.
Add the lacquer glaze to the blender and blend until well combined.
Thread the tofu skewers onto bamboo sticks, if using, and brush with peanut oil.
Grill the tofu skewers for about 5 minutes per side, or until golden brown and crispy.
Brush the tofu skewers with the lacquer glaze mixture during the last minute of grilling.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve immediately.
Serve with steamed jasmine rice or noodles for a complete meal.
Refrigerate any leftovers for up to 3 days and reheat in the oven or on the grill.
